visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy blonde-brown hair, wearing a white shirt and black shorts, walks through the jet bridge and enters an airplane. A flight attendant in a red uniform is visible at the doorway. (2) The camera moves through the airplane cabin, revealing rows of purple and grey seats that are almost entirely unoccupied. Bright, cool indoor lighting illuminates the clean interior. (3) The woman is shown in a medium close-up walking through an airport terminal, now wearing dark sunglasses and a white t-shirt featuring a palm tree print. (4) The scene shifts to the airport arrival hall where a large, dense crowd of people is gathered near the luggage carousels and white architectural pillars. (5) The final phase shows the interior of a car driving on an elevated highway during the day, focusing on the dashboard, a navigation screen, and the urban road ahead.
